floraexpansion.configuration.title: %s Configuration
jei.floraexpansion.apple_core.info.1: Apple cores are planted like saplings.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_core.info.2: Eating apples has a 50% chance to leave behind an apple core.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_jam.info.1: Apple jam is made from apples, sugar, and a glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_leaves.info.1: Apple leaves slowly ripen apples over time.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_leaves.info.2: Right-click by hand to harvest an apple once the leaves are fully ripe.
jei.floraexpansion.apple_leaves.info.3: Bonemeal advances the fruit growth stage.
jei.floraexpansion.basket.info.1: Right-click mature crops and berry-like plants to collect their harvest, or gather mushrooms, flowers, saplings, melons, and pumpkins.
jei.floraexpansion.basket.info.2: Crop-style plants are replanted automatically, including vanilla and many modded crops that use normal crop behavior.
jei.floraexpansion.basket.info.3: Right-click in the air, or Shift-right-click a block, to open the basket's 9 inventory slots.
jei.floraexpansion.blueberry_jam.info.1: Blueberry jam is a preserved berry food made from blueberries, sugar, and a glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.blueberry_jam.info.2: Eat held jam to return its glass jar, or place it to eat individual portions.
jei.floraexpansion.blueberry_pie.info.1: Blueberry pie is eaten as a single food item, like pumpkin pie.
jei.floraexpansion.blueberry_pie.info.2: It takes four times as long to eat as a slice of blueberry pie.
jei.floraexpansion.blueberry_pie.info.3: Eating it grants 5 seconds of regeneration, and it can also be crafted into 4 slices.
jei.floraexpansion.bottled_juice.info.1: Drinking this returns an empty glass bottle.
jei.floraexpansion.bottled_juice.info.2: The bottle is given back to the inventory or dropped nearby if there is no space.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_log.info.1: Use an axe to strip cactus log blocks.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_log.info.2: Stripping can knock loose a cactus spine.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_mosaic.info: Cactus mosaic can be crafted into matching stairs and slabs. The variants support waterlogging and behave like other wooden building blocks.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_spine.info.1: Cactus spines damage living entities that pass through them.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_spine.info.2: They can be attached to floors, walls, or ceilings if the supporting block is sturdy enough.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_wood.info.1: Use an axe to strip cactus wood blocks.
jei.floraexpansion.cactus_wood.info.2: Stripping can knock loose a cactus spine.
jei.floraexpansion.cherries.info.1: Eating cherries has a 50% chance to leave behind a cherry pit.
jei.floraexpansion.cherries.info.2: Cherry pits can be planted to grow cherry trees.
jei.floraexpansion.cherry_jam.info.1: Cherry jam is made from cherries, sugar, and a glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.cherry_pit.info.1: Cherry pits are planted like saplings.
jei.floraexpansion.cherry_pit.info.2: They can also come from eating cherries.
jei.floraexpansion.crate.info.1: Crates store farming supplies such as seeds, saplings, produce, and bone meal. Each crate holds one kind of item, with far more space than a barrel.
jei.floraexpansion.crate.info.2: Right-click inserts the held stack, and quickly right-clicking twice deposits matching items from your inventory.
jei.floraexpansion.crate.info.3: Left-click removes one item, while Shift-left-click removes a full stack.
jei.floraexpansion.crate.info.4: Shift-right-click opens the full storage screen, and a redstone signal locks all hand, hopper, and menu access.
jei.floraexpansion.crate.info.5: Use linen thread to tie a crate shut so it can be broken, moved with its contents, and opened again after placement.
jei.floraexpansion.desert_moss.info.1: Use bone meal on desert moss to make it flower.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seeds.info.1: Flax grows into a two-block crop once it reaches its taller stage.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seeds.info.2: Right-click the upper half with shears to harvest the crop without replanting.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seeds.info.3: Shearing resets flax back to a small lower-half plant so it can regrow faster.
jei.floraexpansion.flax_seeds.info.4: Bonemeal can advance flax growth and helps it reach the harvestable tall stage sooner.
jei.floraexpansion.flowering_desert_moss: Use bone meal to spread up to four flowering patches within two blocks.
Spreads into empty spaces or ordinary desert moss on solid support.
jei.floraexpansion.giant_cactus_shoot.in: Giant cactus shoots can grow into giant cacti on sand or suitable terracotta.
They can transform on their own over time.
Bonemeal can also trigger giant cactus growth when there is enough room.
jei.floraexpansion.giant_cactus_stem.inf: Touching giant cactus stems deals cactus damage.
Use an axe on the stem to harvest the whole connected stem column into cactus slices.
Stems can keep growing upward and may produce cactus flowers at the top.
jei.floraexpansion.glass_jar.info.1: Glass jars can be placed on a supported surface and filled with blueberries, strawberries, cherries, or apples.
jei.floraexpansion.glass_jar.info.2: Eating held jam returns a glass jar to your inventory or drops it nearby if full. Eating the last placed portion leaves an empty jar in place.
jei.floraexpansion.jam_portions.info.1: A full placed jam jar contains four portions. Use the jar while hungry to eat one portion; the last leaves an empty glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.jam_portions.info.2: Use the matching fruit to add one portion. Empty jars accept blueberries, strawberries, cherries, or apples. Hoppers can refill from above or the sides.
jei.floraexpansion.jam_portions.info.3: Eating all four placed portions gives the same total hunger and saturation as eating the full jar from inventory.
jei.floraexpansion.jam_trades.info: Farmer and wandering trader jam offers cost three emeralds for a full jar.
Large blueberry bushes grow through two leafy stages before they start producing berries.
They can be harvested at the first berry stage, then harvested again for double yield when fully ripe.
Harvesting by hand resets the bush to its later leafy stage, and shears pick the whole bush back up.
jei.floraexpansion.linen_thread.info.1: Linen thread can be used on a crate to tie it shut and preserve its contents when broken.
jei.floraexpansion.linen_thread.info.2: Place the tied crate again and right-click it to untie the thread and restore normal access.
jei.floraexpansion.mixed_berries.info: Blueberries, strawberries, and one additional berry make three servings of mixed berries.
jei.floraexpansion.needle_litter.info.1: Right-click with an empty main hand to gather spruce cones and twigs from needle litter.
jei.floraexpansion.needle_litter.info.2: Thicker patches can yield more spruce cones and more twigs.
jei.floraexpansion.needle_litter.info.3: Bonemeal increases the patch up to 4 layers instead of spreading to a new block.
jei.floraexpansion.needle_litter.info.4: Using bonemeal on a full 4-layer patch drops another needle litter block.
jei.floraexpansion.orchard_cherry_leaves: Orchard cherry leaves slowly ripen over time.
Right-click by hand to harvest cherries once fruit has grown.
Bonemeal advances the fruit growth stage.
jei.floraexpansion.pebbles.info.2: Thrown pebbles deal damage and usually drop themselves again on impact.
jei.floraexpansion.placeable_jar.info.1: Use on a supported surface to place the jar. Breaking it preserves the remaining portions.
jei.floraexpansion.placeable_jar.info.2: Jam can still be eaten by using it away from a block; eating it returns a glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.prickly_pear.info.1: Prickly pears are the fruit harvested from prickly pear cacti.
jei.floraexpansion.prickly_pear.info.2: The item can also be planted to place a new prickly pear cactus.
jei.floraexpansion.prickly_pear_cactus.i: Prickly pear cacti slowly ripen prickly pears over time.
Right-click to harvest ripe fruit without breaking the plant.
jei.floraexpansion.scattered_pebbles.inf: Place more scattered pebbles onto the same block to build up the patch.
Right-click with an empty main hand to pick the pebbles back up.
A fuller patch returns more pebbles.
Small blueberry bushes grow through three leafy stages before producing berries.
Right-click a ripe bush to harvest blueberries without uprooting it.
Harvesting resets the bush to its last leafy stage so it can fruit again sooner.
Small blueberry bushes continue growing on their own over time.
jei.floraexpansion.small_cactus.info.1: Place more small cacti onto the same block to build up the cluster.
jei.floraexpansion.small_cactus.info.2: Use a glass bottle to extract cactus juice.
jei.floraexpansion.small_cactus.info.3: Each bottle use reduces the cluster by one stage.
Spiked leather armor can retaliate against direct melee attackers.
Wearing more pieces increases the chance, and 3 or more pieces hit harder.
Fire Aspect on spiked leather armor can ignite attackers, but Thorns cannot be applied.
jei.floraexpansion.spruce_cone.info.2: Thrown spruce cones deal a small amount of damage and briefly slow targets.
jei.floraexpansion.spruce_cone.info.3: On impact, they sometimes drop 1 or 2 spruce nuts.
jei.floraexpansion.spruce_cone.info.4: Burning spruce cones can drop toasted spruce nuts instead.
jei.floraexpansion.strawberry.info.1: Strawberries are planted directly, like carrots or potatoes.
jei.floraexpansion.strawberry.info.2: Only fully grown strawberry plants drop strawberries when broken.
Strawberry cake has fourteen portions. Each bite removes the front or back half of a slice.
Up to three candles can be added to an uneaten cake, including different colors. Light them with flint and steel or a fire charge; use an empty hand near the candles to extinguish them.
Eating the first portion returns all attached candles in their original colors. Each cake portion restores one hunger point.
jei.floraexpansion.strawberry_jam.info.1: Strawberry jam is a preserved berry food made from strawberries, sugar, and a glass jar.
jei.floraexpansion.strawberry_jam.info.2: Eat held jam to return its glass jar, or place it to eat individual portions.
jei.floraexpansion.strawberry_juice.info: Three strawberries and a glass bottle make one strawberry juice. Drinking it returns the bottle.
jei.floraexpansion.wooden_bucket.info.1: Wooden buckets behave like normal buckets for water, powder snow, milk, and bucketable water creatures.
jei.floraexpansion.wooden_bucket.info.2: Each successful use damages the bucket, and it breaks after 10 uses.
jei.floraexpansion.wooden_bucket.info.3: They can scoop lava, but the wooden lava bucket chars into charcoal after a few seconds and sets its carrier on fire.
tooltip.floraexpansion.basket_controls: Right-click to harvest or deposit; Shift-right-click to open.
tooltip.floraexpansion.crate_controls: Right-click to deposit; double-click for bulk deposit. Left-click to extract; Shift-right-click to open.
